name: @playform/ets-hook-dsh-package-pinner
description: Silent package.json VERSION PINNER: hooks fs/observed — the cordis event every tool-layer file write dispatches — and deterministically rewrites every ranged dependency version to its STATIC version ("^0.3.4" → "0.3.4": one leading ^, ~, or = stripped), in every dependency section the config declares (dependencies, devDependencies, peerDependencies, optionalDependencies). Already-static versions, compound/space ranges, wildcards without a prefix, and protocol dependencies (workspace:*, file:, link:, git+, npm: aliases) are left as-is; a pin-policy.json keep-list protects packages whose ranges must stay as authored (discovery: global policyFile → the file's own directory → co-located with the nearest registry.json → built-in empty default; the effective keep-list is the union). Fully API-aware: the manifest is read/rewritten through ctx.fs with a version-guarded replaceIfVersion write (the service owns version tokens) and an explicit sandbox policy, configuration is a validated Schemastery Config schema with defaults, the authoring agent is never notified (the tool result is built from the author's own content and the observation-policy's version record is refreshed by re-emitting fs/observed with the service-issued fresh version), and there is NO update stage — no ncu, no jobs, no subprocess: a pure deterministic P-only rewrite running as a detached contained continuation.
